english.title: Use land for a purpose discontinued under the Town and Country Planning Act 1990
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without planning permission

(A)_[used land,]_
(B)_[caused land to be used,]_
(C)_[permitted land to be used,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY LAND..), for a purpose for which an order under

(D)_[section 102 of]_
(E)_[paragraph 1 of Schedule 9 to]_

the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 had required that its use should be discontinued
english.legislation: Contrary to section 189(1)(a)(i), (c) and (3) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: A fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
